### ITC Immunity Therapy Center - Alternative Cancer Treatment in Tijuana Profile Overview

Alternative Cancer Treatment at ITC Immunity Therapy Center Navigating a cancer diagnosis can be overwhelming, prompting many individuals to explore innovative care pathways beyond standard protocols. Seeking Alternative Cancer Treatment in Tijuana, Mexico allows individuals to access customized medical modalities designed to stimulate the immune system and target malignant cells. For individuals researching a cancer treatment clinic abroad, ITC provides compassionate, evidence-informed medical programs tailored to each individual's unique biological profile, medical history, and overall stage of diagnosis. Request a Consultation With ITC Immunity Therapy Center Share your medical information and receive guidance about available treatment options. Contact ITC for Consultation About ITC Immunity Therapy Center Founded by Dr. Carlos Bautista, ITC - Immunity Therapy Center has established itself as a center focused on individualized care. Dr. Carlos Bautista brings decades of dedicated clinical research and medical leadership to the facility, prioritizing patient dignity, individualized care, and holistic biological preservation. Located in Tijuana, Mexico—just minutes across the U.S. border—the center delivers progressive care pathways to international patients who are searching for alternative cancer treatment abroad in a modern, supportive medical setting. Customized Individualized Medical Protocols Dr. Carlos Bautista Founder & Medical Leadership Holistic Care Immune System Activation & Support How the Treatment Approach Works Understanding how alternative cancer treatment works helps individuals navigate their healthcare options with clarity and confidence. At the core of the center's philosophy is immunity therapy cancer treatment, which combines therapies intended to support natural defenses while targeting malignant cells. Initial Medical Review: Patients submit prior diagnosis reports, imaging results, blood tests, and medical history for detailed physician evaluation. Individual Treatment Planning: A specialized care pathway is created based on the diagnosis, tumor location, biological health condition, and treatment goals. Treatment Explanation: Physicians explain the objective of each therapy—such as laser therapy, hyperthermia, or biomagnetic therapy—ensuring patients understand the process and expected benefits. Medical Monitoring: Daily clinical assessments and periodic blood tests track treatment response and manage side effects in real time. Follow-Up Support: Post-treatment protocols, lifestyle advice, and continued communication guidance are provided for long-term recovery after returning home. Coordination With Existing Doctors: Patients are encouraged to share medical updates with their home healthcare providers to maintain seamless medical care. Discuss Your Cancer Treatment Options Contact ITC Immunity Therapy Center to learn what information is needed for a personalized medical review. Speak With a Specialist Today Treatment Eligibility and Patient Assessment Evaluating eligibility for an integrative cancer treatment program involves a thorough review of medical records by qualified physicians. Candidacy depends on factors such as cancer type, stage, organ functionality, previous conventional treatments (chemotherapy or radiation), and current physical strength. Whether exploring alternative treatment or complementary therapy alongside standard care, a structured medical evaluation determines whether the patient can safely participate in the program. Alternative Cancer Treatment Cost and Packages Understanding the overall cancer treatment cost abroad allows families to plan financially. ITC maintains a transparent pricing model to ensure international patients can evaluate their options without hidden fees. | Base Package Price | Cancer Types Treated at ITC | Standard Inclusions | | --- | --- | --- | | Base Package Price | Cancer Types Treated at ITC | Standard Inclusions | | $18,995 | Breast Cancer Prostate Cancer Lung Cancer Colon & Colorectal Cancer Pancreatic Cancer Ovarian & Cervical Cancer Liver & Kidney Cancer Leukemia & Lymphoma Melanoma & Skin Cancers Brain Tumors Stomach & Esophageal Cancer Sarcoma & Bone Cancers | Physician consultations & daily care Customized alternative therapy suite Daily IV nutrition & natural supplements Medical monitoring & nursing care Local transportation assistance Patient companion support services | Patients seeking comprehensive alternative cancer therapy options can request a personalized quote based on their required length of stay and customized therapeutic needs. Risks and Important Medical Considerations Evaluating cancer treatment decisions requires objective review of medical facts, individual diagnosis, and potential risks: Cancer care outcomes vary based on individual biology, stage, and previous therapies. Benefits and limitations of alternative therapies should be reviewed carefully prior to initiating treatment. Possible side effects, detox reactions, or physical changes should be discussed with medical professionals. Patients should avoid delaying necessary standard treatments without consulting their primary oncologist. Seeking a second opinion can help patients make balanced, confident healthcare decisions. Patient Travel and Support Services ITC Immunity Therapy Center provides extensive logistical support for international visitors traveling to Tijuana, Mexico. The facility is located near San Diego International Airport (SAN), and dedicated shuttle services facilitate seamless border crossings and local transit to medical appointments and affiliated hotel accommodations. Frequently Asked Questions What is alternative cancer treatment at ITC Immunity Therapy Center? Alternative cancer treatment at ITC refers to customized modalities—such as specialized immunotherapies, hyperthermia, and biomagnetic therapy—designed to support the immune system and target cancer cells. As a specialized cancer immunotherapy treatment center, ITC designs programs tailored to each patient's needs. Who may be eligible for alternative cancer treatment at ITC Immunity Therapy Center? Eligibility depends on cancer type, stage, physical strength, organ function, and medical history. Patients undergo a medical evaluation prior to acceptance. How much does alternative cancer treatment at ITC Immunity Therapy Center cost? Treatment costs start at $18,995 for standard multi-week programs. Total costs vary based on protocol duration, specific therapies required, and diagnostic needs. Can alternative cancer treatment be combined with conventional cancer treatment? Yes, many patients utilize integrative therapies alongside conventional treatments. Any combination should be coordinated with qualified physicians to evaluate safety and compatibility. What risks should patients consider before choosing alternative cancer treatment? Patients should consider potential side effects, detox responses, treatment limitations, and personal health conditions before starting therapy. How do international patients arrange cancer treatment at ITC Immunity Therapy Center? International patients submit medical records for review, receive a treatment plan and quote, and coordinate travel with ITC's support team. What medical information should patients provide before consultation? Patients should provide recent pathology reports, imaging scans (CT, MRI, PET), blood work, diagnosis summaries, and a history of previous treatments. When Sadie was 19, she found out she was very sick with Hodgkin’s Lymphoma, a kind of cancer. At first, she had a small bump on her neck, but then she started having trouble breathing and felt pain in her chest. Sadie’s mom searched all over to find help. That’s when they found ITC. Sadie was not sure about it at first, but she liked how ITC’s plan was gentle and would not hurt her body too much. At ITC, Sadie got treatments that did not hurt a lot. After just two weeks, she felt better. Her chest did not hurt anymore, she could breathe easily, and she had more energy. After three and a half months, her cancer was gone! Sadie loved the kind nurses and doctors at ITC. Dr. Bautista talked to her honestly, and everyone made her feel safe. Sadie said, “I was welcomed by everyone here, which was really nice, especially when I was scared.” ITC helped Sadie go from feeling scared to feeling hopeful and happy again. Karla felt scared and sad, but she did nt give up hope. She went to ITC for help in May 2013. At first, Karla’s son was not sure about ITC, but Karla believed it could help her. When she got there, she saw how kind and caring everyone was. The treatments were gentle and did not hurt her body too much. Karla liked how the doctors always told her what was happening and how she was getting better. After three weeks of treatment at ITC in Mexico, Karla went back home. She kept doing what the doctors told her, like eating healthy food and taking her medicine. One day, Karla noticed the lumps on her breast were gone! She felt so happy and proud of herself. Beware, the doctors lie to you at this clinic. I recently went down for 3 weeks of treatment for breast cancer. Even though I told them I didn't want their chemo treatment, they assured me it would be really helpful, they would only be using 10% and I would not lose my hair. They lied. I lost all of my hair which started 1 week after I returned home. When contacting my doctor he told me that was so unusual and recommended Minoxidal (which actually makes your hair shed worse before it regrows). This happened to 2 other women I kept in contact with. So it wasn't that unusual. When I followed up to find out what they gave me, it was the MOST toxic of all the chemotherapy treatments and they gave me a 50% dose, not 10%. It makes me question everything they are administering here. It has been extremely stressful which is opposite from what I need healing cancer. I am guessing they push chemo so much because they want results. I later found out the type of cancer I have, isn't responsive to chemotherapy. I would have hoped a clinic like this would have tests to check this. The total disrespect for me to make an informed decision makes me motivated to share my story to help protect others. I regret going here. Spend your money with doctors who are honest. I will say that the nurses were spectacular. They deserve a 10 star rating. But the doctors deserve a -10 for taking advantage of their patients at their most vulnerable.
This was my husbands 5th trip to ITC. He goes annually for check-ups and to get an "immune boost"! He is always treated like family and gets quality care. We are happy with all aspects of ITC but above all we are happy with the results of his treatments!
The ITC doctors, nurses, and staff were absolutely phenomenal. I was given specialized and personalized care not only for the three weeks I received therapy at their facility, but also in the months that followed as I continued home therapy. These people are in the business of caring for those with sickness and they do it with compassion and wisdom. Their confidence is encouraging and I have seen a complete turn around in my health.

Beware, the doctors lie to you at this clinic. I recently went down for 3 weeks of treatment for breast cancer. Even though I told them I didn't want their chemo treatment, they assured me it would be really helpful, they would only be using 10% and I would not lose my hair. They lied. I lost all of my hair which started 1 week after I returned home. When contacting my doctor he told me that was so unusual and recommended Minoxidal (which actually makes your hair shed worse before it regrows). This happened to 2 other women I kept in contact with. So it wasn't that unusual. When I followed up to find out what they gave me, it was the MOST toxic of all the chemotherapy treatments and they gave me a 50% dose, not 10%. It makes me question everything they are administering here. It has been extremely stressful which is opposite from what I need healing cancer. I am guessing they push chemo so much because they want results. I later found out the type of cancer I have, isn't responsive to chemotherapy. I would have hoped a clinic like this would have tests to check this. The total disrespect for me to make an informed decision makes me motivated to share my story to help protect others. I regret going here. Spend your money with doctors who are honest. I will say that the nurses were spectacular. They deserve a 10 star rating. But the doctors deserve a -10 for taking advantage of their patients at their most vulnerable.

Beware, the doctors lie to you at this clinic. I recently went down for 3 weeks of treatment for breast cancer. Even though I told them I didn't want their chemo treatment, they assured me it would be really helpful, they would only be using 10% and I would not lose my hair. They lied. I lost all of my hair which started 1 week after I returned home. When contacting my doctor he told me that was so unusual and recommended Minoxidal (which actually makes your hair shed worse before it regrows). This happened to 2 other women I kept in contact with. So it wasn't that unusual. When I followed up to find out what they gave me, it was the MOST toxic of all the chemotherapy treatments and they gave me a 50% dose, not 10%. It makes me question everything they are administering here. It has been extremely stressful which is opposite from what I need healing cancer. I am guessing they push chemo so much because they want results. I later found out the type of cancer I have, isn't responsive to chemotherapy. I would have hoped a clinic like this would have tests to check this. The total disrespect for me to make an informed decision makes me motivated to share my story to help protect others. I regret going here. Spend your money with doctors who are honest. I will say that the nurses were spectacular. They deserve a 10 star rating. But the doctors deserve a -10 for taking advantage of their patients at their most vulnerable.
This was my husbands 5th trip to ITC. He goes annually for check-ups and to get an "immune boost"! He is always treated like family and gets quality care. We are happy with all aspects of ITC but above all we are happy with the results of his treatments!
The ITC doctors, nurses, and staff were absolutely phenomenal. I was given specialized and personalized care not only for the three weeks I received therapy at their facility, but also in the months that followed as I continued home therapy. These people are in the business of caring for those with sickness and they do it with compassion and wisdom. Their confidence is encouraging and I have seen a complete turn around in my health.
